import json, os, time, urllib.error, urllib.request
auth = os.environ["GW_TOKEN"].strip()
if not auth.lower().startswith("bearer"):
    auth = "Bearer " + auth
pid = os.environ["HARNESS_PATIENT_ID"].strip()
store = os.environ["HARNESS_STORE"].strip()

def call(path, payload):
    req = urllib.request.Request("https://mott-booking-gw.mail.mybcat.com" + path, data=json.dumps(payload).encode(), method="POST", headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "User-Agent": "mybcat-cli", "Authorization": auth})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120) as r:
            return r.status, json.loads(r.read().decode() or "{}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, e.read().decode(errors="replace")[:200]

def latest_slots():
    s, b = call("/availability", {"store": store, "from": "thursday", "to": "thursday", "slot_minutes": "15", "after": "none", "before": "none", "time_pref": "latest"})
    slots = ((b.get("result") or {}).get("slots") or []) if isinstance(b, dict) else []
    return slots

def count():
    s, b = call("/appt-list", {"patient_id": pid, "store": store})
    return ((b.get("result") or {}).get("count")) if isinstance(b, dict) else None

assert count() == 0, "ABORT: dummy subject has appointments; need 0"
before = latest_slots()
assert before, "no slots returned"
print("STEP1_LATEST_FIRST=%s" % before[0].get("start"))
target = before[0]
s, b = call("/sign", {"verb": "appt.book", "target": pid, "store": store, "reason": "new-booking", "params": {"doctor": target.get("doctor_id"), "start": target.get("start"), "end": target.get("end"), "type": os.environ.get("HARNESS_EXAM_TYPE", "674597395")}})
booked = isinstance(b, dict) and b.get("success") is True
if not booked:
    booked = (count() or 0) > 0
print("STEP2_BOOKED=%s slot=%s" % (booked, target.get("start")))
assert booked, "could not book the last slot; aborting without side effects"
try:
    time.sleep(2)
    after = latest_slots()
    print("STEP3_LATEST_FIRST_WHILE_BOOKED=%s" % (after[0].get("start") if after else "none"))
    excluded = bool(after) and after[0].get("start") != target.get("start")
    print("EXCLUSION=%s" % excluded)
finally:
    for _ in range(3):
        c, b2 = call("/appt-list", {"patient_id": pid, "store": store})
        appts = ((b2.get("result") or {}).get("appointments") or []) if isinstance(b2, dict) else []
        if not appts:
            break
        for a in appts:
            aid, day = a.get("appointment_id"), (a.get("start") or "")[:10]
            call("/sign", {"verb": "appt.cancel", "target": aid, "store": store, "reason": "patient-request", "params": {"appt_id": aid, "day": day}})
        time.sleep(2)
    final_count = count()
    print("CLEANUP_FINAL_COUNT=%s" % final_count)
time.sleep(2)
restored = latest_slots()
print("STEP5_LATEST_FIRST_RESTORED=%s" % (restored[0].get("start") if restored else "none"))
sat_s, sat_b = call("/availability", {"store": store, "from": "saturday", "to": "saturday", "slot_minutes": "15", "after": "none", "before": "none", "time_pref": "latest"})
sat_count = ((sat_b.get("result") or {}).get("count")) if isinstance(sat_b, dict) else sat_s
print("STEP6_SATURDAY_COUNT=%s" % sat_count)
print("PROBE_DONE")
PY
